title: trainerframe
summary: Program.Trainer.cs implements the trainer session and window: CMSG_TRAINER_LIST request with range/flag gating, SMSG_TRAINER_LIST decode, ClassTrainer four-piece shell, greeting text, 11-row service list with state coloring (grey known / gold available / red unaffordable-unavailable), wheel + real draggable scrollbar, selection detail pane (icon in EmptySlot, name, level requirement, cost, description), Train button (CMSG_TRAINER_BUY_SPELL) with success/failure packets and learned-spell observation, Exit + close button, requirements tooltip per row.

openItems.text: Flat list: no collapsible skill-line tree headers and no Collapse All control (Benilla/backport groups services under fold-able skill-line headers)
No filter dropdown (Available / Unavailable / Already Known visibility toggles)
Title is the hardcoded string 'Trainer' - the NPC's name is never resolved into it
No NPC portrait on the window ring
No player money purse display, and cost renders as plain text rather than the coin-icon money rig with red unaffordable tint
